scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish complete covered-contact fields or independently qualified reference methods without accepting unresolved physical convergence.

lagged_original_equation_recovery.scope: Recover a rejected rigid counterpart equation without changing physical time or its audited previous state.

numerical_recovery.scope: Recover the original rigid equation with lagged-friction numerical stages and unchanged final current-force gates.

independent_rigid_audit.scope: Independently audit original-control rigid histories with direct body force/moment and fresh Panda steps.
independent_rigid_audit.limitations: Rigid-body net force/moment and fresh actual old-state Panda-step residuals are reconstructed independently without importing the coupled rigid solver. Rigidity is checked against an independent finite-rotation map, and joint integration/kinematics/contact forces use actual saved states. An explicitly allowed failed prefix is not a complete history. This does not establish physical contact/space/time convergence, native load-model accuracy or verified warmed cost.

feedback_prefix.scope: Compare complete same-law rigid/deformable original protocols and separate resolved-load feedback from elastic recovery error.
feedback_prefix.limitations: All866 audited matched original states share the same represented geometry, mass, material, full Panda model, ground, control sequence, timestep and IPC/friction law. Source wrenches are independently decomposed at actual body force points about each current body COM, including support and friction moments. Separate resolved-load linear replays isolate history/load feedback from deformable linear-versus-nonlinear recovery at3 material-frame tensor snapshots; these error norms are not additive. Code0 and small algebra errors do not establish physical geometry/contact/time/regularization convergence, finite-footprint model accuracy or warmed accuracy/cost. The480-tet polyhedron's known geometry and concentration limitations remain. An explicitly allowed prefix is not complete original-history evidence.

metis_original_field_qualification.scope: Compare all saved paired-reference arrays and full stress fields without a new solve.
metis_original_field_qualification.limitations: Complete saved histories are compared at identical physical inputs and byte-identical geometry. By default initializer bytes must match; the explicit resolved-initializer option instead checks every initializer array at the original state budget and retains its measured difference. Independent force-audit results are checked and retained, not reassembled in this field comparison. This proves numerical equivalence only for these saved states; it establishes neither physical convergence nor a controlled timing improvement or warmed production cost.
